title: Cloud Sync usage
summary: Diceroll's Cloud Sync page, Usage tab: players with data, storage used against the product's total, syncs today and save conflicts, storage by tier against each limit, what's stored (saves, older versions, settings) and where players sync from.
compare: Read from the directory, never computed in the console. The numbers agree with Setup: 4,812 players with data = 3,120 Free + 1,402 Standard + 290 Deluxe; 18.4 GiB of 50 GiB = 9.5 + 5.5 + 3.4 GiB by tier = 11.6 + 6.6 + 0.2 GiB by kind; 41 Free players over 80%.

Storage by tier shows each tier's limit in words, players with data, storage used, the median per player and who's over 80%, as warning text only where it needs attention, with the players whose saves wait for room linked from the foot.

What's stored is one stacked bar over a table of the three kinds with their size; older versions say they count toward each player's storage. The card doesn't repeat the 18.4 GiB total from the Storage used tile.

Where players sync from is a table of each platform the product builds for, with players this week and the last sync; itch.io shows None yet and the foot links to Integration (the header already says it isn't seen).
A player's own data is on Users → the player → Data, and the card foot says so; this tab has no per-player table.

Words: "player" for a game (Diceroll), "person" or "account" for an app (DJDL); storage in MiB and GiB, never MB; numbers and units never break across lines. products.integration's Cloud Sync card must say "Storage per person: 256 MiB by default (Standard uses the default)" to match this page.
Phone: the stats stack two by two, each tier row becomes a block (tier and storage used, then the rest), and the two cards stack.

Wide (1600px and up): the four stat tiles span the page; Storage by tier and What's stored take the main column and Where players sync from is the 400px aside. Below 1600 What's stored and Where players sync from sit side by side about 2:1 and stack on phone.
Spacing and copy pass (2026-10-08): the screen sets no spacing of its own (kit primitives only), and each fact shows once, where it's most useful.

findings.issue: What's stored bar stretched, the end cap notched, three links in one card, per-tier limits repeated in sub-lines.
findings.resolution: Bar capped at 640px with a 4px minimum end segment and a 2px gap instead of a border; pair is top-aligned; tier sub-lines keep only "Also unlicensed players"; the foot link is dropped (one link per card); platform subtitle is "This week"; column header "Near limit" in both tabs; "Updated" removed. Not done: bar beside a 3-item legend, a two-column phone mini-grid.

findings.issue: Keep player counts on Usage only (UX4) vs keep (UX2)
findings.resolution: declined: Resolved in favour of Usage owning the counts; the Setup rows keep the tier fact only.
